questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this API handles partial updates and conflicting bookings? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Two requests arrive at the same moment, each booking practitioner 3 for 09:00-09:30 on the same day. What is the outcome?
choices: Both succeed with 201 because the check happens before the insert in separate steps
Exactly one gets 201 and the other gets 409, because the overlap check and insert are inside one lock
Both get 409, because each sees the other's pending booking
One gets 201 and the other gets 422 from the model validation

questions.prompt: A client sends PATCH /v1/appointments/8 with body {"notes": null}. What happens?
choices: 422, because null is not allowed for any field
200; notes is cleared and the start time and duration are unchanged
200; all fields not mentioned are reset to None
200; the request is a no-op because None values are ignored

questions.prompt: A client sends DELETE /v1/appointments/8 twice for a booked appointment, and then books a new appointment for the same practitioner and time. What happens?
choices: 204 then 204; the new booking succeeds because cancelled rows are skipped by the overlap check
204 then 204; the new booking returns 409 because the cancelled row still occupies the slot
